title: [𝒜/𝒦] ≃ [A/𝒦] (alcove reduction under (F5)–(F6))
body_html:
Alcove reduction $[\mathcal{A} / \mathscr{K}] \;\xrightarrow{\sim}\; [A / \mathscr{K}]$

Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a fixed closed alcove of $A$ (fundamental domain under the $N$-action). Define $[\mathcal{A} / \mathscr{K}]$ on facets in $\mathcal{A}$ with $$\Hom_{[\mathcal{A} / \mathscr{K}]}(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E}) := \begin{cases} \hat K_\mathcal{E} & \mathcal{E} \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F}}, \\ \emptyset & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$

Assume the fine-structure hypothesis on $A$:

(F5) $\hat N_\mathcal{F} = \{n \in N : n \mathcal{F} = \mathcal{F}\}$, i.e.\ stabilizer and fixator agree on $\mathscr{F}$.

(F6) Within $\overline{\mathcal{F}}$, facets in the same $N$-orbit coincide: $n \mathcal{E}_1 = \mathcal{E}_2$ with $\mathcal{E}_i \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F}}$ forces $\mathcal{E}_1 = \mathcal{E}_2$.

These imply $\hat K_\mathcal{F} = \{g \in G : g \mathcal{F} = \mathcal{F}\}$.

Lemma. $\Hom_{[\mathcal{A}/\mathscr{K}]}(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E}) = \Hom_{[A/\mathscr{K}]}(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E})$.
proof_html:
For $n \in N$ with $\mathcal{E} \subseteq \overline{n\mathcal{F}}$, $n^{-1}\mathcal{E} \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F}} \subseteq \mathcal{A}$. By (F6), $n^{-1}\mathcal{E} = \mathcal{E}$, so by (F5) $n \in \hat N_\mathcal{E}$. Hence $\Hom_{[A/\mathscr{K}]}(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E}) = K_\mathcal{E} \hat N_\mathcal{E} = \hat K_\mathcal{E}$. $\square$

Corollary. The functor $[\mathcal{A} / \mathscr{K}] \to [A / \mathscr{K}]$ is an equivalence of categories.

Pulling back coefficient systems along this equivalence (and along [[node:coefficient_systems.A_over_K_equivalence]]) gives $\Coeff_G(\BSigma) \to \Coeff_\mathscr{K}(\mathcal{A})$, an equivalence between the global category and a much smaller one on the alcove.
